user.title: Labeled Features
user.description: Leaders, features and followers are always configured with labels. These settings are the instance-level values that used to live as labels on the template sensors; labels on the created sensor entities still win over them.

data_description.prefix: Sensors are created as sensor.<prefix>s_state and sensor.<prefix>_areas_state. The default 'labeled_feature' reproduces the legacy entity IDs. This cannot be changed later.
data_description.leader_label: Label that identifies leader entities and the areas scanned for 'Provides:' declarations.
data_description.default_mode: Used when no '<Scoped Feature> Mode:' label or override matches.
data_description.default_script_call_mode: Forward-looking default. The YAML Leaders automation still reads Script Call Mode from labels on the sensor.
data_description.mode_overrides: One per line, using label syntax: 'Area Night Mode: All'.
data_description.script_call_mode_overrides: One per line, using label syntax: 'Area Sleep Timer Script Call Mode: NonBlocking'.

error.invalid_prefix: The prefix must be a valid slug (lowercase letters, digits and underscores).
error.prefix_in_use: Another Labeled Features instance already uses this prefix.
error.invalid_mode_override: Every line must look like '<Scoped Feature> Mode: Leader|Any|All'.
error.invalid_script_call_mode_override: Every line must look like '<Scoped Feature> Script Call Mode: Blocking|NonBlocking'.

init.description: The entity slug prefix cannot be changed here; rename the entities in the entity registry instead.

options.leader: Leader — only the leader that drove the tick
options.any: Any — OR across every leader of the triple
options.all: All — AND across every leader of the triple
